critical_code_review_comments: routes/chat.py is well structured (~470 lines, single responsibility, all endpoints behind get_current_user dep). MongoDB _id is excluded in every query ({'_id': 0}). Good.
send_message endpoint correctly broadcasts via WS and falls back to Web Push for offline participants — proper try/except around push (won't block message send if push fails).
_auto_join_channels runs on every GET /api/chat/conversations — small DB cost; could be moved to login flow as one-shot. Non-blocking.
ChatMessage model uses ISO string timestamps (good for sort stability); deleted_at nullable for soft-delete pattern is in place but no delete endpoint exists yet (future feature).
DM endpoint uses {'$all': [a, b], '$size': 2} — correct dedup query for 1:1 DMs.
Upload endpoint reads entire file into memory before size check — for 25MB it's fine; consider streaming for larger limits later.
Templates filter logic `not t.get('roles') or any(...) or 'yonetim' in user_roles` — yonetim shortcut is sensible (admins see everything).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope UI selectors verified (16/16 data-testids functional). 2 advanced flows (real-time WS typing/read across 2 browsers, Web Push) not tested due to single-browser limitation.
